title: 2022-23 Panini Prizm Monopoly - Prizm #4 Jayson Tatum Celtics
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2022-23 Panini Prizm Monopoly sports trading card features Jayson Tatum of the Boston Celtics. The card is part of the base set and has a card number of 4. It also has a Prizm parallel/variety, making it a great addition to any collection. 

The card is perfect for fans of the National Basketball Association (NBA) and collectors of sports trading cards. It is manufactured by Panini and is from the 2022-23 season. This card is not autographed and is a must-have for any fan of Jayson Tatum or the Boston Celtics.
